topSignals.title: Priority stack check — Elcogen and Topsoe both confirmed quiet for a second consecutive week.
topSignals.text: Direct re-check of both companies' news feeds shows no new item: Elcogen's most recent post remains the Sept 21 Metrosert testing-cooperation announcement, and Topsoe's press-release/news pages still list the H1 2026 half-year statement as the latest dated release. Elcogen News, Topsoe News

topSignals.title: PJM's 6 GW data-center backstop procurement remains unfiled, four days after FERC's suspension order, with no new timeline.
topSignals.text: No refiling, relaunch date, or further PJM statement was found in the window; the mechanism's new effective date stays Feb 28, 2027 pending resubmission. This keeps the nearest-term regulatory test case for behind-the-meter/on-site generation (including SOFC) open-ended. Utility Dive

topSignals.title: Broad quiet day; the next catalysts are now inside a week.
topSignals.text: Extended English/German searches across stack tech, deployments, competing on-site power, market/financials, research and LCOE datapoints turned up nothing dated to the last 24-48h beyond items already on file. Germany's EEG-Novelle committee hearing is now 2 days out (Oct 5), the Netzpaket hearing 4 days out (Oct 7), with a final vote targeted around Oct 16; the KWK-Gesetz (CHP law) goes to cabinet Oct 14; Bloom Energy reports Q3 earnings Oct 27 (24 days out).

items.text: Elcogen (priority): Quiet — newsroom re-checked directly; most recent post remains the Sept 21 Metrosert multi-year testing-cooperation announcement. No new stack/cell, capacity, or partnership news in the window. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform in volume production at ELCO I Tallinn. Elcogen News
Topsoe (priority): Quiet — press-release and news pages re-checked directly; most recent dated item is still the H1 2026 half-year statement. No SOEC/SOFC-specific item in the window. Topsoe News

Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin: no new stack/cell-technology announcements found in the window beyond already-logged items (financial/market news for Bloom, FuelCell Energy and Ceres covered below). Note: a widely-circulating "Ceres Power shares soar on China data centre power deal" headline re-surfaced in search results but is dated Nov 2025 (Weichai licensing deal) — not new, excluded.

Live — see Top Signal #2:* PJM's 6 GW backstop procurement remains suspended with no refiling or new auction date four days after FERC's Sept 29 order; new effective date (if resubmitted successfully) is Feb 28, 2027.

No change, approaching:* Germany's EEG-Novelle/Netzpaket Redispatch-Vorbehalt track — committee hearings now 2 days (Oct 5, EEG) and 4 days (Oct 7, Netzpaket) out, final vote still targeted around Oct 16; coalition negotiators continue signaling the clause is likely to be dropped.
No change:* Germany's KWK-Gesetz (CHP law) cabinet consideration remains scheduled for Oct 14.

No change* in the last 24-48h on: DOE/FERC large-load interconnection rulemaking (Apr 30, 2026 deadline); ITC 48E (30% fuel-cell credit) and 45V hydrogen credit; Virginia data-center electricity tax, New York permit moratorium, Texas development pause, EPA turbine NSPS; California's seven data-center bills signed Sept 21; Ireland's data-centre grid-connection rules — all as previously logged.
Bloom Energy (BE): No new operational or financial disclosures in the window. Q3 earnings now 24 days out, due Oct 27.

FuelCell Energy (FCEL): No new operational disclosures in the window; Nov 10, 2026 lead-plaintiff deadline (Fit Energy cost-overrun disclosure suit) still pending; backlog remains $3.6B per the Q3 transcript.
Ceres Power (CWR.L): No new market-moving news since the Sept 17 UK grid-connection-delay whitepaper.

lcoe.text: No new cost, efficiency, capex/opex, or gas/H2/electricity price datapoint published in the last 24-48h beyond already-logged items (Pan et al. $3.49/kg LCOH; Kourougianni et al. >30% annualized-cost reduction for rSOC+PV; Kim 2026 50–60% net electrical efficiency for commercial SOFC systems; Sept 25 EIA Henry Hub summer-2026 average of $2.93/MMBtu).

Pending calendar (updated): PJM backstop procurement — new effective date Feb 28, 2027, resubmission timeline still TBD; German EEG/Netzpaket committee hearings Oct 5 (EEG, in 2 days) / Oct 7 (Netzpaket, in 4 days), final vote targeted Oct 16 (in 13 days); German KWK-Gesetz cabinet consideration Oct 14 (in 11 days); Bloom Q3 earnings Oct 27 (in 24 days); FCEL lead-plaintiff deadline Nov 10; New Mexico air-quality permit deadline for Project Jupiter Nov 23.
